newsitem.title: UK: EBRD's Freeman says successor may be named soon.
newsitem.headline: EBRD's Freeman says successor may be named soon.

text.p: Ron Freeman, first vice-president of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), said on Sunday he hoped his successor would be named within the next month.
Freeman is leaving the EBRD after six years to rejoin U.S. investment bank Salomon Brothers as co-head of its global investment banking operations.
Asked at a news conference at the EBRD annual meeting if he had any news on the succession, he replied:

"I do have news but not news that I can disclose publicly. I have a candidate whom I have had my eye on for a long time. I'm hoping that this person will be able to free himself of other professional obligations and come forward."
He hoped EBRD President Jacques de Larosiere would be able to make an announcement within a month "and maybe a lot sooner."
